# Agent System Documentation Instructions

Keep design documents concise, evidence-based, and aligned with the applicable agent
definitions and shared specs.

- Record the status, evidence, and fallback for every platform capability that affects
  a role boundary.
- Define hand-off artifacts once in the relevant design of record; agent files and
  skills should link to it rather than copy it.
- Do not present an unverified tool, credential boundary, or orchestration behavior as
  fact.
- Keep skills focused on reusable procedures and designs focused on roles, gates, and
  failure routing.
